description: The corporate action notices (dividends, splits, reverse splits, mergers) and token contract addresses an issuer has published itself through the IoMarkets.tech Notice Publisher, signed with the issuer's own ed25519 key: what is active now, and what was amended or retracted, in order. Says whether the issuer's domain has been verified (its site serves the signing key). Prefer this to a guess from a web page. Read-only; the issuer id is the one in https://iomarkets.tech/issuer/<id>. Same data as https://iomarkets.tech/api/publisher/<id>.json.

issuer.description: The issuer id, such as acme-bank.

name: get_issuer_notices
title: An issuer's own signed notices
